response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a PS5 Slim disc-edition console with one controller, but none of the seller's functional claims (no overheating, all ports working, never opened) or the 'pads' plural and UK receipt claims are supported by the photos, so it must be priced at worst case as an untested single-pad unit.
